description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or Clever Conjurer
